offering_description.value: Makes and sells refrigerated fresh dog and cat food and treats for pet owners, sold mainly through grocery, mass, club, pet specialty and online retailers. It cooks and refrigerates its recipes in company kitchens and distributes them through retailer supply chains.

primary_products.value: fresh refrigerated dog food; fresh refrigerated cat food; dog treats

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery, mass merchant, club, pet specialty and e-commerce retailers; B2C: dog and cat owners buying in stores and online

end_markets.value: pet food; pet specialty retail; grocery and mass retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: fresh and refrigerated pet food and treats sold to retailers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets its own pet food brands; OEM / manufacturer: cooks and packages its own recipes in company kitchens, sold to retailers

geography_served.value: US national: Sold across the United States, with small sales in Canada and other markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: Focused on fresh refrigerated pet food and treats for dogs and cats

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to national and regional retail chains; third-party retail: grocery, mass, club and pet specialty stores; online: retailer websites and e-commerce platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Pet food rules under FDA and state feed laws, plus AAFCO labeling standards and food safety rules

notes: Facility locations and minor international sales may have changed; details are approximate.
